payload.entry: DONE (single tale agent for sase-17d.10.1.4). Step 1: removed the dead #agent-llm-calls-scroll/#agent-file-scroll fallbacks (both _get_scroll_container now return the VerticalScroll parent or None, try/except kept around self.parent); migrated test_agent_fold_transitions_llm_calls.py to deck semantics (focused_tools_view() sentinel: focused Tools view takes l/h/L/H, unfocused leaves them to the tree; _HintFoldApp stubs _arm_panel_fold_hint_mode); dropped the view_mode kwarg in test_agents_tab_current_project_seed; jump-panel search-overlay test now uses deck_area.focused_panel().show_search_overlay()/hide_search_overlay(); deleted test_zoom_file_cap_subtitle_points_to_editor. Repairs 1 and 2 were already on master (114fbca89). Step 3 rows 1-8 migrated with new helpers in _ace_agents_png_snapshot_helpers.py (main_deck_scroll, scroll_main_section_to_top, select_main_card, resolved_main_section, pin_decks_paged): monitor states x7 (section asserted at BOTH widths only at 120: at 90 columns the detail column is 0-19 cells so the section cannot be targeted or matched as text; see sase-18p), family conversation monitor phase (select reply card), family shells monitor metadata (regen; also scrolls the jump panel to its end so 'just check' is on screen), gate output (reply card + main_deck_scroll), family fold levels (scroll_main_section_to_top agent-xprompt; wrap-to-top asserts scroll_y==0 and output-variables), collapsed panel (active_main_card()=='summary', no 'view:' chip), tribe clan summaries, tribe prompts. Multi-card tests pin PAGED (pin_decks_paged) because a borderline document flipped spread/paged between runs (lost-120 monitor golden). Verified: 4 step-1 modules 46 passed at the time; visual modules pass under --check.

DONE. Step 3 rows 9-17 migrated: tribe panel four-level (main_deck_scroll in _settle_tribe_visual), swarm clan panel (main_deck_scroll; dropped the '--code' assertion because the compact CLAN MEMBERS jump panel only lists '.family'), slow tools fold ladder (scroll_main_section_to_top slow-tool-calls; deleted dead AgentDetail import, _LLM_CALLS_FOOTER_RE, _rendered_llm_calls_footer and the three legacy scroll helpers), linked-repo diff file panel (Files deck active_scroll; pins paged), commit messages panel (split per deck: Main deck golden agents_commit_messages_panel + new Files deck golden agents_commit_messages_files_panel, because the half-width Main|Files split wraps file names; waits for on-screen text instead of blind ctrl+d; Files title now carries the count so 'files [1/3]' became 'FILES'/'1/3'), external-repo diff (final wait_for_visual_idle + pinned paged; the convergence failure was a missing final idle wait), llm_calls full case (#agent-deck-panel-0-tools-scroll, pinned virtual height re-measured 79 -> 94, stable over 4 runs; zoom_panel_modal.py path string replaced by same-length widgets/decks/main_view.py), metadata search (deck search overlay, focused_panel().search_command()), waiting unknown zoom modal: test and golden deleted. Deviation from the plan: the Wait section and the '[beads] run-bead ◐, done-bead ●, open-bead ○' line live in the identity HEADER above the deck, not in a Main card, so the replacement scenario is test_agents_waiting_unknown_detail_header_png_snapshot (press d to expand the header) with golden agents_waiting_unknown_header_200x40 (200 columns because the header is unreadable at 120); tokens are asserted individually since the line wraps. Optional clean-ups done: zoom fixtures docstring, ' · view:' split in proc_shells.

DONE. Step 2a: DeckPanelChromeMixin._resolve_accent now reads app.current_theme.secondary (app.theme_variables is rebuilt lazily and held #004578 in 224/250 probe resolutions), DeckPanel subscribes to app.theme_changed_signal (refresh_chrome + repaint of Main spread separators; MainDeckView spread render key now includes the accent). New tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/test_deck_chrome.py (13 tests, 11 fail without the fix). Step 2b: _chrome_width() passes the true label budget max(1, size.width - 4) (80 before layout); tests pick a width with size.width-4 < L <= size.width and assert the compact tier with no '…'. Extras in the same spirit: deck_subtitle gained a count-less tier (spread tag -> counts -> bare labels -> slice, so 'main 1 · files 0 · too' style clipping is avoided; unit tests in test_deck_titles.py) and the inline search help subtitle picks a width-aware tier (search_help_subtitle in _deck_search_host.py + unit test), which fixes '[n/N] next/pre…' in a LEFT_RIGHT half panel. Step 4: three coverage goldens added: agents_decks_single_files_spread_160x40 (160 columns so the 'spread' tag fits; the probe result is fed by hand through panel._on_files_probe_result because DeckPanelFilesMixin.on_worker_state_changed gates on a nonexistent Worker.StateChanged.is_done, so a Files deck never spreads live: task sase-18m), agents_decks_single_main_paged_120x40 (160-line response, no pin_paged, waits for RenderMode.PAGED and asserts no 'spread' tag), agents_decks_left_right_search_committed_120x40 (vertical_line, ctrl+f before search, ',' '/' prompt, enter n, waits for committed and '[2/'). Step 5/6: every changed or created PNG opened and inspected (contact sheets and old-vs-new crops). Groups: Main accent recolor #004578 -> teal #24837B with identical geometry (~2.7k px each, ~100 goldens, incl. spread separators), title/subtitle tier changes on narrow panels, agents_decks_single_empty ';' palette hint, top-bar 'view:'/(p) removal in migrated modules, migrated goldens regenerated. command_palette_default_120x40 restored with git checkout; the 7 orphan goldens (context/file/metadata/multi-file zoom modal, file zoom search, view picker five layouts, family member override) plus agents_waiting_unknown_zoom_modal deleted by hand because the full run ends partial (unrelated failures) and does not remove stale goldens. Step 7 (final): just fix-tui-screenshots --check = 1028 passed, 6 failed; the 6 are all the unrelated set: 4 test_ace_png_snapshots_command_line.py nodes (8 failed in the earlier full update run; load-dependent convergence timeouts; typed_ghost golden drift and empty_state setup timeout also reproduce on a clean HEAD worktree) -> task sase-18o; test_top_bar_usage_attention_narrow and test_top_bar_usage_badges_crowded_narrow (wait_for_startup timeouts, reproduced on clean HEAD) -> task sase-18n. Other tasks filed: sase-18m (Files spread probe bug), sase-18p (90-column layout squeezes the deck column to 0-19 cells). Step 8 live sase screenshot (160x48, this workspace's venv, v0.17.1+1379.g55936f429.dirty): single Main, Main|Files split, Main|Main, Context|Reply (0 then ctrl+j), collapsed node panels (ctrl+s) and zoomed panel (Z) all inspected: Main accent teal, tab strips and subtitles unclipped (no '…'). Step 9 bench (pytest -s -m slow tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk.py, load average 27.8 -> 34.3): rail absent next p50 15.21/p95 29.96, prev 15.00/32.65 (sase-17d.3 flag-on: 14.44/19.28, 14.84/21.85); rail painting next 15.71/30.04, prev 17.89/31.45 (baseline 15.53/21.92, 13.91/18.30); agents_jk_and_panel_navigation next 16.38/23.50, prev 16.32/20.38; clan fold level 1 next 12.12/15.66, prev 13.02/16.35 (budget 16 ms: miss); selected tribe fold level 1 next 51.20/92.40, prev 45.11/57.07 (budget 40: miss); fleet hung_host 13.51/36.97 & 12.76/35.23, reconnect_churn 14.51/26.75 & 13.79/24.66, event_burst 14.81/22.00 & 15.84/34.02 (budget 16: all three miss); axe cached next 13.06/42.50 (test_bench_axe_jk fails on both trees); patches 1.49/1.91. 6 failed / 4 passed: exactly the known pre-existing load misses (bench harness not repaired; p95s are host-load noise, not compared against a fresh no-cutover baseline). Step 10: just fix clean; sase tool run check (81b7c2990dfbd7bb1f8606bf80d8868e) passed fmt/ruff/mypy/flags/pyscripts/waits/changelog/terminology and stopped at symvision (unused public AgentSurvivorsError/Survivor in _kill_termination.py and environ_has_launch_key in process_tree.py from b7cfa069c, files not in this diff) and _lint-toobig (tests/tool/test_settlement.py 1048 lines) - both unrelated; just test-scoped: 6380 passed, 5 failed (test_visual_fixture_host_paths [command_line test file], test_help_modal_refresh_for_tab_rebuilds_sections, test_parallel_step_does_not_show_agent_prompt, test_llm_calls_panel_fallbacks_use_configured_wall_time, test_agents_command_palette_exposes_save_marked_group) - all 5 reproduce on a clean HEAD worktree; pytest --collect-only tests/ace/tui/visual collects (1004 items); step-1 modules and tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/ pass (210 passed). The plan's monitor routing was replaced by foreground runs (single-turn session). PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: none beyond tasks sase-18m/18n/18o/18p.
Step 1 land-agent repairs and the first eight visual tests migrated to the deck API; the affected modules pass under just fix-tui-screenshots --check, and the 4 step-1 non-visual modules pass.
Remaining nine visual test migrations done (waiting unknown zoom modal test and golden deleted, replaced by a header scenario); all pass under the final full --check.

Chrome fixes (deterministic Main accent, border label budget), 3 coverage goldens, live screenshots inspected, full update inspected and full --check clean except the unrelated command_line and top-bar sets (tasks sase-18o, sase-18n), bench numbers recorded in the notes.
